sections.Profile:
"Deadly Weapon" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1990. It features a police and crime theme with three flippers, no ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. Designed by John Trudeau and Jon Norris, with artwork by Constantino Mitchell, David Moore, and Jeanine Mitchell, it is part of the Gottlieb System 3 series with a production run of 803 units.
